frame: finger_local_m, baked registered vertices, identity collider transform

canonical_hash.rule: Sort unique quantized vertices and normalized outward planes within each hull, then sort hulls. D/R require exact canonical hash equality; no fallback.

fidelity.interpretation: A bounded sampled CAD screen only. Bore purpose and physical mounting remain unverified. Internal hull faces are excluded from surface fidelity.
fidelity.inside_solid_rule: Closed solid: a point is inside a hull when every normalized plane residual is <= +1e-7 m. Union membership means inside any hull.
fidelity.contact_outward_rule: Use documented signed scalar times normal. Pad outward is minus force direction for a finger sensor and plus force direction for a coupon sensor. Never fit or try both ray directions.

phases.G: Use the same full initializer. Export cooked data before play; verify 300 bricks/930 native links and robot properties after initialization. Coupon stays parked; zero measured contact steps. Independent fidelity audit required.
phases.D: Only after independent G audit passes. Re-query the actual collider data and match the approved canonical hashes before closing. Keep the exact B0 coupon center.
phases.R: Only after independent D audit passes. Use the same proxy and approved G hashes; offset the coupon by +2 mm along hand X only. No tuning after reserved feedback.
